title: No check feeds observe_day_quarters a day whose mean is exactly 1e-6
claim: Mutant c38d53ab787ddbfa at price_model.py:252 survives the full gate (RED-AS-NULL), yet the probe's accepted_mutant moves: baseline accepted=0, mutant accepted=1.
mechanism: Reach: reach_real_price_days_at_boundary=0 is asserted not measured; separable only via a hand-built vector whose np.mean is exactly 1e-6 (48x0.0 + 48x2e-6). Check that should have failed (D3.M4): tests/features.py ~18732-18792 has no zero-mean boundary case.

evidence.unit: quarter-days accepted for a day of 48x0.0 and 48x2e-6 (mean exactly 1e-6; baseline 0)
evidence.machine: box D3-rem: Linux x86_64, nproc 4, Intel Xeon @ 2.10GHz, 16 GB, venv-ci CPython 3.14, alone on the box
evidence.contention_note: deterministic value; probes ran while box D3-rem gates ran (load1 ~1); the full-gate walls in the T1 table are provisional

perturbation.change: the mutant edit at price_model.py:252 applied in memory by the probe (48 quarters 0.0 + 48 of 2e-6); full gate: fullgate.py run --key c38d53ab787ddbfa

metric_definition: quarter-days accepted for a day of 48x0.0 and 48x2e-6 (mean exactly 1e-6; baseline 0)
phenomenon_property: A price day with mean <= 1e-6 is rejected by the quarter-shape learner

null_control.note: null arm where the edit cannot matter; identical floats under both arms

proposed_fix_scope: tests only: a check at the boundary input above that pins the baseline value (accepted=0)
